entry.title: Find what we already know
entry.use_when: Useful answers may already be sitting somewhere.
entry.freshness: Review after failed use or a source/contract change.
entry.limitations: A prompt and artifact contract; requires an existing assistant or human practitioner.

pattern.activation: the answer may already exist in permitted notes, documents or prior work, but is hard to recover.

use_cases.title: Recover the basis for an old decision
use_cases.outcome: An evidence map with source dates, disagreements and missing facts.

links.why: Use the recovered evidence to distinguish what a process actually does from what a guide says it should do.
